'''Godelieve Quisthoudt-Rowohl''' is a German politician who served as a [[Member of the European Parliament]] from 1989 until 2019. She is a member of the [[Christian Democratic Union (Germany)|Christian Democratic Union]] in Lower Saxony, which is a part of the [[European People's Party]]. She most recently served as the [[European People's Party]]'s coordinator of the International Trade Committee (INTA), chairwoman of the UK Monitoring Group of INTA, vice-coordinator of the Committee on Human Rights (DROI) and vice-chairwoman of the Delegation for relations with Canada.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.quisthoudt-rowohl.de/|title=Prof. Dr. Godelieve Quisthoudt-Rowohl MdEP|last=MdEP|website=Prof. Dr. Godelieve Quisthoudt-Rowohl, MdEP|language=de|access-date=2018-04-18}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
Quisthoudt-Rowohl studied chemistry at [[Katholieke Universiteit Leuven|University of Leuven]]. After graduating, she did a PhD at the [[Max Planck Institute]] for [[Biophysical Chemistry]] in Göttingen from 1972 to 1973.<ref name="GSB">{{cite web|url=http://www.gleichstellungsbuero.uni-hannover.de/fileadmin/institut/pdf/100317_NL_LM_Uni.pdf#page=3 |title=Mentorein: Dr. Godelieve Quisthoudt-Rowohl |work=Mentoring in Wissenschaft und Wirtschaft |pages=3 |date=2011-02-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120315020859/http://www.gleichstellungsbuero.uni-hannover.de/fileadmin/institut/pdf/100317_NL_LM_Uni.pdf |archive-date=2012-03-15 |access-date=2012-03-12 |language=de |format=PDF |url-status=dead }}</ref>

From 1974 to 1978 Quisthoudt-Rowohl continued researching at the [[Hannover Medical School]].<ref name="Labor">{{cite web|url=http://www.laborfuergestaltung.de/fileadmin/downloads/arbeitsbericht.pdf#page=98 |title=Dr. Godelieve Quisthoudt-Rowohl: CDU Niedersachsen |work=Arbeitsbericht der CDU/CSU-Gruppe im Europäischen Parlament 2007 - 2008; CDU/CSU-Gruppe im Europäischen Parlament |pages=96 |date=2008-10-31 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120315020847/http://www.laborfuergestaltung.de/fileadmin/downloads/arbeitsbericht.pdf |archive-date=2012-03-15 |access-date=2012-03-12 |language=de |format=PDF |url-status=dead }}</ref> From 1979 to 1989 she served as ''Akademische Rätin'' of the [[University of Hildesheim]].<ref name="Labor" /> There she also worked as an academic employee at the institute for applied glottology and later became an academic council at the institute for applied glottology. From 2002, she was teaching at its Institute of Social Sciences.<ref name="Votewatch">{{cite web|url=http://www.votewatch.eu/cx_mep_details.php?euro_parlamentar_id=531&lang=de |title=Votevatch |publisher=Votewatch.eu |access-date=2012-03-11}}</ref><ref>''CDU-Frau ist jetzt Professorin: Uni ehrt Europaabgeordnete Quisthoudt-Rowohl'' in Hildesheimer Allgemeine Zeitung vom 7. März 2009.</ref> On 6 March 2009, she became a professor at the department of education and social sciences.<ref name="GSB" /><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uni-hildesheim.de/de/30352_37464.htm |title=Universität Hildesheim {{pipe}} Kommunikation und Medien {{pipe}} Artikel |publisher=Uni-hildesheim.de |access-date=2012-03-11}}</ref> She gave guest lectures at the University of Kaliningrad, at the European Business School and at Harvard University.

== Political career ==
===Career in national politics===
In 1990 Quisthoudt-Rowohl was a CDU board member in Lower Saxony. From 1994 to 2012 she was national board member for the CDU. She is counted as one of the principal supporters of [[Angela Merkel]]'s bid for Chancellorship in 2004.

From 1990 to 1996 Quisthoudt-Rowohl was a national board member of the Frauen Union for the CDU. She was assistant member of the European committee of the German Bundestag. From 2005 to 2009 she was the leader of the city association CDU in Hildesheim.
<ref name="GSB" /><ref>Oskar Niedermayer: ''Die Parteien nach der Bundestagswahl 2002.'' VS Verlag 2003, {{ISBN|3-8100-3722-2}}, {{ISBN|978-3-8100-3722-0}}, p. 74.</ref> From 1990 to 1996 she served on the national board of the ''Frauen Union''.<ref name="GSB" />

===Member of the European Parliament, 1989–2019===
[[File:Quisthoudt-Rowohl Mit Angela Merkel.jpg|thumb|Quisthoudt-Rowohl with Angela Merkel]]
From 1989 Quisthoudt-Rowohl was a member of the [[European Parliament]] where she was one of the senior deputies for the CDU in the European Parliament with [[Elmar Brok]] and [[Karl-Heinz Florenz]]. She was a member of the executive board ([[Quaestor]]) from 1997 to 2007<ref name="GSB" /><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.europarl.europa.eu/sides/getDoc.do?type=PRESS&reference=TW-20040720-S&format=XML&language=DE#SECTION7 |title=Tagungswoche - 20-07-2004(s) |publisher=Europarl.europa.eu |access-date=2012-03-11}}</ref> and was a member of the board of the [[European People's Party (European Parliament group)|EPP]].

As member of the Committee on International Trade, she advocated European car manufacturers against dumping prices of aluminium rims by Chinese manufacturers.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.europarl.europa.eu/sides/getDoc.do?pubRef=-//EP//TEXT+WQ+E-2010-5928+0+DOC+XML+V0//DE&language=DE |title=Schriftliche Anfrage - Antidumpingzölle auf Einfuhren von Aluminium-Fahrzeugrädern aus China - E-5928/2010 |website=Europarl.europa.eu |date=2011-07-22 |access-date=2016-01-28}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.europarl.europa.eu/sides/getDoc.do?pubRef=-//EP//TEXT+WQ+E-2010-5927+0+DOC+XML+V0//DE&language=DE |title=Schriftliche Anfrage - Antidumpingzölle auf Einfuhren von Aluminium-Fahrzeugrädern aus China - E-5927/2010 |website=Europarl.europa.eu |access-date=2016-01-28}}</ref> At her request, the committee decided to criticize Turkey urgently because Turkey still does not allow Cyprus to export goods to Turkey. Further, Turkey should ratify the Ankara Protocol as soon as possible. Finally she urged Turkey to enforce copyrights effectively and so to stop [[brand piracy]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.euractiv.de/erweiterung-und-partnerschaft/artikel/eu-ruft-trkei-zu-weiteren-reformen-auf-003371 |title=Erweiterung und Nachbarn |publisher=EurActiv.de |access-date=2012-03-11 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111009155237/http://www.euractiv.de/erweiterung-und-partnerschaft/artikel/eu-ruft-trkei-zu-weiteren-reformen-auf-003371 |archive-date=2011-10-09 }}</ref> Quisthoudt-Rowohl holds the European ban on incandescent lamps for patronizing and undemocratic, because the parliament and the public were not involved.<ref name="cdu-peine.de">{{cite web|url=http://www.cdu-peine.de/euparlament/2009-02-1.pdf |title=Infobrief 2/2009 |author=Dr. Godelieve Quisthoudt-Rowohl, MdEP |work=cdu-peine.de |date=2009-02-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120315020847/http://www.cdu-peine.de/euparlament/2009-02-1.pdf |archive-date=2012-03-15 |access-date=2012-03-12 |language=de |url-status=dead }}</ref> Ms Quisthoudt-Rowohl was also involved in the ceilings for the mobile phone fees in the EU.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://eur-lex.europa.eu/LexUriServ/LexUriServ.do?uri=OJ:C:2010:047E:0032:0049:DE:PDF |title=PROTOKOLL DER SITZUNG VOM 15. JULI 2009: C 47 E/32 |work=eur-lex.europa.eu |date=2010-02-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121014092836/http://eur-lex.europa.eu/LexUriServ/LexUriServ.do?uri=OJ:C:2010:047E:0032:0049:DE:PDF |archive-date=2012-10-14 |access-date=2012-03-12 |language=de |format=PDF |url-status=dead }}</ref>

She wants to strengthen [[small and medium enterprises]] (SMEs) by increasing participation in international trade and by an intensification of relations to the USA.<ref name="cdu-peine.de" /> She was involved in a new energy agreement between Russia and the EU.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.robert-schuman.eu/print_lettre.php?num=304&lg=de#art-3470 |title=Fondation Robert Schuman |work=robert-schuman.eu |date=2007-05-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120313164239/http://www.robert-schuman.eu/print_lettre.php?num=304&lg=de |archive-date=2012-03-13 |access-date=2012-03-12 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.europarl.europa.eu/sides/getDoc.do?language=en&type=IM-PRESS&reference=20070521IPR06882 |title=Time to relaunch energy dialogue with Russia |author=Committee on International Trade |work=europarl.europa.eu |date=2007-05-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140109032415/http://www.europarl.europa.eu/sides/getDoc.do?language=en&type=IM-PRESS&reference=20070521IPR06882 |archive-date=2014-01-09 |access-date=2012-03-12 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Quisthoudt-Rowohl was formally a member of the [[Committee on Development]]. There, she brought European student exchanges and projects to promote democracy in China and India on the way (since 2010).<ref>[http://www.angelika-niebler.de/htm/plenarwoche1010.htm]  {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110716031914/http://www.angelika-niebler.de/htm/plenarwoche1010.htm|date=July 16, 2011}}</ref> In 1999 she ensured that the Commission gave higher priority to children's rights.<ref>Europäisches Parlament: [http://www.europarl.europa.eu/sides/getDoc.do?pubRef=-//EP//TEXT+OQ+O-1999-0063+0+DOC+XML+V0//DE&language=DE Betrifft: Zehnter Jahrestag des Übereinkommens über die Rechte des Kindes] vom 10. November 2009.</ref> Quisthoudt-Rowohl works on the implementation of the Gender-Mainstreaming, in particular she speaks up for boys and young men to end their current discrimination.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.europarl.europa.eu/sides/getDoc.do?pubRef=-//EP//TEXT+WQ+E-2007-0127+0+DOC+XML+V0//DE&language=DE |title=Schriftliche Anfrage - Unzureichende Förderung von Jungen und jungen Männern - E-0127/2007 |publisher=Europarl.europa.eu |date=2006-12-08 |access-date=2012-03-11}}</ref> In 2003 she suggested a review of the use of EU funds for the Palestinian Authority, to ensure that the money is not wasted for corruption or funding of terrorist groups.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.europarl.europa.eu/sides/getDoc.do?pubRef=-//EP//TEXT+OQ+O-2003-0001+0+DOC+XML+V0//DE&language=DE |title=Mündliche Anfrage mit Aussprache - EU-Gelder an Palästinensische Autonomiebehörde - O-0001/2003 |publisher=Europarl.europa.eu |date=2002-06-17 |access-date=2012-03-11}}</ref>

From 1994 to 1999, Quisthoudt-Rowohl was Deputy Chairman of the Committee on Energy, Research and Technology.<ref>Christian de Fouloy: ''The European Strasbourg register 1994.'' Martinus Nijhoff Publishers, 1994, {{ISBN|0-7923-2726-8}}, {{ISBN|978-0-7923-2726-4}}, p. 93.</ref><ref>''The European Union Encyclopedia and Directory 1999.'' Routledge, 1999, {{ISBN|1-85743-056-5}}, {{ISBN|978-1-85743-056-1}}, p. 322.</ref> 2005 she initiated the first talks between European institutes for oceanography and the European Parliament to discuss the rapidly advancing climate change, global sea level rise, marine resources, the increasing threat and damage from tsunamis, earthquakes and extreme weather events and the continuing destruction of the marine environment in order to discuss sustainable use and work on a consensus on priorities for future research.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ifm-geomar.de/index.php?id=2459 |title=IFM-GEOMAR: 051020 |publisher=Ifm-geomar.de |date=2005-10-20 |access-date=2012-03-11 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111002050003/http://www.ifm-geomar.de/index.php?id=2459 |archive-date=2011-10-02 }}</ref>

In June 2018, Quisthoudt-Rowohl announced that she would not stand in the [[2019 European Parliament election in Germany|2019 European elections]] but instead resign from active politics by the end of the parliamentary term.<ref>[https://www.hildesheimer-allgemeine.de/news/article/godelieve-quisthoudt-rowohl-kandidiert-nicht-erneut-fuers-eu-parlament.html Godelieve Quisthoudt-Rowohl kandidiert nicht erneut fürs EU-Parlament] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180627100258/https://www.hildesheimer-allgemeine.de/news/article/godelieve-quisthoudt-rowohl-kandidiert-nicht-erneut-fuers-eu-parlament.html |date=2018-06-27 }} ''[[Hildesheimer Allgemeine Zeitung]]'', June 5, 2018.</ref>

==Political positions==
In 2011 Quisthoudt-Rowohl proposed changes to the Parliament's international trade committees (INTA) guidelines for the rights of foreign investors under future EU trade deals that were said to be in line with industry demands.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.truth-out.org/investment-rights-stifle-democracy/1301547600 |title=Investment Rights Stifle Democracy |work=truth-out.org; Corporate Europe Observatory |date=2011-05-05 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110412214529/http://www.truth-out.org/investment-rights-stifle-democracy/1301547600 |archive-date=2011-04-12 |access-date=2011-05-05 |quote=EPP members Daniel Caspary, Godelieve Quisthoudt-Rowohl (both Germany), Christofer Fjellner (Sweden) and Emilio Menéndez del Valle from the Socialists and Democrats (Spain) have also proposed changes that are strikingly in line with industry demands. |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Recognition==
[[Transparency International]] awarded Quisthoudt-Rowohl in line of the Integrity Watch Program with best mark of 0 at the External Activity Indicator. Being present at 85% of the plenary sittings she is one of the front-runners in the EPP group.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cdu-peine.de/mandate/euparlament/eu-kommunal10_2011.pdf |title=Prof. Dr. Godelieve Quisthoudt 1 -Rowohl, MdEP |quote=EU-Kommunal : Nr. 10/2011 : 24.10.2011 |website=Cdu-peine.de |access-date=2016-01-28}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Quisthoudt-Rowohl is married and has four adult children. She lives in Hildesheim in Lower-Saxony. Quisthoudt-Rowohl is chairman of the advisory board of the Hildesheim Episcopal Foundation "Gemeinsam für das Leben" (German: ''Together for life'').<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.gemeinsam-fuer-das-leben.de/ueber-die-stiftung/stiftungsbeirat |title=Stiftungsbeirat - Gemeinsam für das Leben |website=Gemeinsam-fuer-das-leben.de |access-date=2016-01-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141111125949/http://www.gemeinsam-fuer-das-leben.de/ueber-die-stiftung/stiftungsbeirat |archive-date=2014-11-11 |url-status=dead }}</ref> She is decorated with the [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany]].<ref name="Votewatch" /> Quisthoudt-Rowohl is a native Dutch and French Speaker as well as completely fluent in German, she can also speak English and Italian.
